description: This file defines the 'Element' class within the 'Goteo\Library\SuperForm' namespace, representing an element in a super form system. It includes properties for form element attributes, methods for rendering, type determination, and managing associated views, as well as implementing interfaces for array access and resource management.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties for handling its data, rendering, and associated view templates. Implements ArrayAccess to allow array-like property access and Resource for resource management.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Element instance with optional data array, setting properties, processing children, and determining type and view.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view template path based on the class name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of the element based on the class name.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML content of the element, either from a direct string or by rendering its view.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create an Element instance from data and immediately render it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the element using its associated view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the element to a string, returning its rendered HTML, handling exceptions gracefully.
